stack.orm: TypeORM against PostgreSQL 16 (entities mirror schema.sql; schema.sql is authoritative)
stack.validation: class-validator DTOs wired to validation-rules.json messages via a custom exception factory

conventions.modulePerEntity: One Nest module per aggregate (auth, users, products, cart, orders). Controllers implement exactly the openapi.yaml operations — same paths, status codes, and operationIds; no extra endpoints.
conventions.errors: Every thrown HttpException is shaped by GlobalExceptionFilter into the ErrorResponse envelope {error: {code, message, details}} with codes from validation-rules.json errorCodes.
conventions.transactions: placeOrder runs in a single DB transaction: re-check stock (BR-003) → snapshot lines (BR-005) → decrement stock → insert order + items (BR-006 fee from SHIPPING_FLAT_FEE) → empty cart (BR-004).
conventions.ownership: Cart and order queries are always scoped by the JWT user id; a foreign resource id yields 404 NOT_FOUND, never 403.
conventions.moneyType: NUMERIC(10,2) ↔ string in TypeORM; converted to number only at the serialization edge with 2dp.

src/.main.ts: bootstrap: global prefix /api/v1, CORS from CORS_ORIGIN, global pipes + filter
src/.app.module.ts: imports Config, Database, Auth, Users, Products, Cart, Orders

config/.configuration.ts: typed env loading (.env.example is the contract)
config/.validation.ts: fails fast on missing/invalid env vars

database/.seeds/: seed-products.ts — the 8 fixed-UUID products from schema.sql

auth/.auth.service.ts: bcrypt hash/verify; creates the user's cart on register (REQ-001); 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; 409 EMAIL_TAKEN (BR-001)
auth/.dto/: RegisterDto, LoginDto — rules from validation-rules.json register/login

users/.users.service.ts: findByEmail/create; no controller (no user-profile endpoints in scope)

products/.products.service.ts: pagination/search/category/sort per openapi params; isActive only

cart/.cart.service.ts: merge-on-add, quantity 1-99 + stock checks (BR-003 → 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK); every mutation returns the full cart

orders/.orders.service.ts: transactional checkout (see conventions); order_number ORD-###### from a sequence; status transitions guard (BR-007, state-transitions.md)
orders/.order.entity.ts: mirrors orders (status enum: PENDING PAID SHIPPED DELIVERED CANCELLED)

test/.app.e2e-spec.ts: supertest flows per user-features.md acceptance criteria
